game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Woodcutter Clearing Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing, a woodcutter's clearing: the forest ranger must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing: a woodcutter's clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Woodcutter Clearing, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round, cursed treants strike the fairy lantern, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the fairy lantern from cursed treants in Woodcutter Clearing: keep the roll_call meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: roll_call drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how roll_call changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed treants in Woodcutter Clearing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while roll_call > 0.
